chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 415: The Son – A Eunuch’s Ghastly Pregnancy and an Office Conspiracy
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang navigates a double-agent crisis. The Supervisory Heavenly Office plots with Zuowandao. But the real horror is a pregnant eunuch showing off his “son.”
og_title: The Pregnant Eunuch’s Son – Chapter 415 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
og_description: The Office joins hands with Zuowandao to strike Zhuge Yuan. Li Huowang waits for the right moment. And a eunuch shows off the impossible: a belly full of life.
twitter_title: A eunuch’s pregnancy and a triple-agency trap await in this slow-burn chapter of Dao Gui Yi Xian
twitter_description: Li Huowang plays both sides as the Supervisory Heavenly Office recruits the Zuowandao. The climax isn’t a fight—it’s a fat eunuch opening his robe.

lore_anchors.definition: A powerful ceremonial almanac or divination text linked to Zhuge Yuan; the Office demands nothing else in their attack.
Rank structure within the Supervisory Heavenly Office; “Wind” and “Arrow” likely denote operational divisions or signal types.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Office free the Zuowandao?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Vice Commissioner knows Zhuge Yuan will fight to the death with them; releasing and coordinating with the Zuowandao draws Zhuge into a predictable ambush where the Office can seize the Six Luminaries Scripture.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does the eunuch’s pregnancy mean?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a literal body-horror miracle from Zhengde Temple. For a palace eunuch, having a biological “son” overrides all moral or political concerns—hence his indifference to the temple being “demonic.”

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is this the first time Li Huowang seems compromised?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No, but the chapter shows his growing institutional entanglement: he’s meeting Office agents on his own initiative and protecting his cover, even at Zhuge Yuan’s expense.
